kind_of_thing.quote: A pumpkin seed, also known as a pepita (from the Mexican Spanish: pepita de calabaza, 'little seed of squash'), is the edible seed of a pumpkin or certain other cultivars of squash.

extinct.why: Pumpkin seeds come from pumpkins and squash plants that are still grown and eaten today, so they are not extinct.

kind_of_plant.why: Pumpkin seeds come from pumpkins, which are squash plants grown in gardens and eaten as vegetables.
